references.text: The right thigh was given to the priest as part of the peace offering, corresponding to the boiled shoulder that the priest took from the ram in the Nazirite vow.
Moses instructed Aaron and his sons to boil the meat at the entrance of the tent of meeting, which corresponds to the boiled shoulder in the Nazirite ceremony.
At the consecration of priests, the right thigh and unleavened bread from the basket were taken, corresponding to the elements the priest took in the Nazirite ceremony.
Describes the basket with unleavened bread, unleavened cakes, and unleavened wafers that the Nazirite was to bring, which the priest took in verse 19.
The Nazirite was to shave off his consecrated hair at the entrance of the tent of meeting, which is the background for the expression 'after he has shaved off his consecrated hair'.
Describes unleavened cakes and wafers as part of the grain offering, corresponding to the unleavened cakes and wafers mentioned in the Nazirite ceremony.
